name: X (Twitter)
summary: There's no approval queue. Money is the gate: since Feb 2026 the X API is pay-per-use, with no free tier. Composio dropped its managed X app, so you have to bring your own.

composio.note: Composio removed managed Twitter credentials in Feb 2026. You need your own developer app and credits.

capabilities.label: Read posts & users
capabilities.why: About $0.005 per post read and $0.01 per user read

capabilities.label: Post on behalf of users
capabilities.why: $0.015 per post, $0.20 if the post contains a link

gates.label: Prepaid credits
gates.plain: No review, but every call is billed.

steps.title: Sign up for a developer account in the Developer Console
steps.detail: console.x.com. Accept the developer terms and describe your use case.
steps.human: Sign up with the X account that will own the app

steps.title: Add a payment method and buy credits
steps.detail: Prepaid credits are deducted per request, and calls fail at zero. Set a spending limit and auto-recharge. First-time buyers get $20 in free credits, plus a match of the first auto-recharge up to $50. Pay-per-use is capped at 3M post reads a month.
steps.human: Add a card, buy credits and set a cap

steps.title: Create the app, set Read+Write, OAuth 2.0
steps.detail: User authentication settings: type Web App, callback URL (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback), website URL. Posting needs a user-context token, not the app bearer token.
steps.agent: Configure user auth settings and the callback; test PKCE

steps.title: Model your per-user cost
steps.detail: Agents that read timelines can burn credits fast. Cache reads and dedupe.
steps.agent: Estimate monthly cost from expected calls per user
